properties.title: One Frame, Full Heartbeat: ECG-Free 4D Cardiac Cine MRI Synthesis via Radial-Decomposed Flow Matching

membership.reason: PhaseFlow3D predicts phase-conditioned latent rectified flow trajectories decoded into 3D myocardial displacement fields over the full cardiac cycle.
membership.counting_boundary: Verified L1 predictive hybrid cardiac motion world model (WT_ORGAN, BP_FORECAST).

properties.backbone: Phase-conditioned latent rectified flow + Radial Contraction Decomposition (physics radial prior + learned residual) warping ED 3D MRI

properties.flow: Single ED 3D CMR + canonical cardiac phase -> latent rectified flow velocity -> Radial Contraction Decomposition -> 4D cine CMR + displacement fields

properties.purpose: ECG-free 4D cardiac cine MRI synthesis, EF/volume-curve estimation, and synthetic augmentation.
properties.environment: Combined ACDC and M&Ms multi-centre cardiac MRI benchmarks

assertions.rationale: Piecewise linear cardiac phase p_t = [sin phi_t, cos phi_t] anchored at ED and ES.
Encodes single ED 3D CMR volume into latent space z_0.
Latent cardiac motion trajectory evolving across the cardiac cycle.
Rectified flow transport predicting full-heartbeat 4D myocardial deformation trajectory.
Latent rectified flow coupled with Radial Contraction Decomposition.
Physics-informed centripetal radial contraction direction field relative to LV centroid.
Combines physics-informed radial branch with image-conditioned residual displacement.

Evaluates synthesized full-heartbeat future cardiac frames from a single ED 3D volume against ground-truth 4D cine MRI sequences on n=166 ACDC + M&Ms test patients (Table 1 & Table 2, p. 11: PSNR 34.97 dB, SSIM 0.928, LPIPS 0.017, FID 2.020, FVD 0.683, EF MAE 12.85%, Vol Corr 0.845, Vol R^2 0.054, Vol MAE 0.110; Wilcoxon p <= 10^-11 vs all baselines on EF MAE, Vol R^2, Vol MAE).
ECG-free 4D cine CMR synthesis and physiological EF/strain quantification.
Best EF MAE, only positive LV volume-curve R2, and best FID/FVD over full cardiac cycle.
FID and FVD distributional quality on ACDC + M&Ms.
Multi-dataset validation on ACDC and M&Ms + 5 downstream tasks (99.2% segmentation Dice retention).
Rectified flow velocity operates in latent space.

evidence_fragments.content: We present PhaseFlow3D, a generative framework that synthesizes a complete 4D cine sequence from a single end-diastolic (ED) three-dimensional (3D) volume without ECG dependency. To capture the asymmetric dynamics of systole and diastole, PhaseFlow3D encodes the cardiac cycle as a piecewise linear phase anchored at the ED and endsystolic(ES)timepoints;atinference,thisphaseisinstantiatedfromapopulation-levelcanonical template, requiring no patient-specific temporal information. Conditioned on this phase, a rectifiedflowmodelsynthesizesacardiacmotiontrajectoryinlatentspace.ARadialContraction Decompositionthendecodeseachlatentstateintoa3Ddisplacementfield,combiningaphysicsinformed radial component for centripetal myocardial contraction with an image-conditioned residual for rotation and out-of-plane motion. Every frame is generated by directly warping the ED volume, bypassing variational autoencoder decoding. On the combined ACDC and M&Ms benchmark, PhaseFlow3D achieves the best EF mean absolute error, the only positive leftventricular volume-curve𝑅2, and the best distributional quality among all compared methods, with ablations confirming the contribution of each component.

RadialContractionDecomposition.Cardiacmotionisdecomposedintoaphysics-informedradialcomponent and a data-driven residual, and every frame is synthesized by warping the real ED volume, bypassing VAE decoding. To our knowledge, this is the first use of a radial decomposition as a structural prior in a generative synthesis framework. •Physiologicalsupervisionwithoutsegmentingsynthesizedimages.EFandvolume-curvelossesarecomputed by warping the ground-truth ED mask through the predicted displacement field, so segmentation runs only on real images and clinically relevant metrics supervise training without domain shift.

capability_assessments.rationale: Phase-conditioned latent rectified flow + physics-informed radial contraction decomposition forecasting full-heartbeat 4D myocardial deformation from a single ED MRI without action conditioning (L1).

legacy_cells.B: One Frame, Full Heartbeat: ECG-Free 4D Cardiac Cine MRI Synthesis via Radial-Decomposed Flow Matching
legacy_cells.C: Wang, Shiyi, Sun, Ruochen, Li, Xiang, Liu, Peirong, Xing, Fangxu
legacy_cells.O: ACDC groups: normal control, dilated cardiomyopathy, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, prior myocardial infarction, and abnormal right ventricle; M&Ms multi-disease cardiac cohort
legacy_cells.S: Can a complete 4D cine CMR sequence, including a cardiac motion trajectory, be synthesized from one end-diastolic 3D volume without ECG input?
legacy_cells.T: ACDC subjects from five pathological groups and subjects in the multi-centre, multi-vendor, multi-disease M&Ms CMR dataset
legacy_cells.AI: 3D cardiac CMR volumes (full cine sequences during training; single ED volume at inference)
legacy_cells.AJ: Frozen CineVAE3D per-frame 3D VAE encoder; PhaseProjector MLP; VelocityUNet4D 3D U-Net with temporal/spatial attention; RadialContractionHead; ImageEncoder3D and ImageConditionedDeformDecoder3D; SpatialTransformer3D
legacy_cells.BN: Anatomy-derived radial direction field around the LV centroid; radial motion is phase-conditioned and zero at ED; localized by a dilated LV mask; residual deformation regularized by bending-energy and folding losses
legacy_cells.BS: A complete 4D cine CMR sequence synthesized by warping the ED volume, plus per-frame 3D displacement fields
legacy_cells.BV: Rectified flow-matching loss; local normalized cross-correlation; bending-energy and folding regularization; ED identity; ES Dice/volume/EF supervision; dense LV volume-curve loss; residual radial-projection penalty
legacy_cells.CA: Approximately 29 hours on one NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU for the two-stage schedule
legacy_cells.DQ: ACDC: 150 subjects (105 train, 15 validation, 30 test); M&Ms: 150 labeled training, 34 validation, and 136 testing subjects; combined test set n=166
legacy_cells.DZ: FID 2.020; FVD 0.683 on the combined ACDC and M&Ms test set
legacy_cells.EA: Folding voxels: 0.0005% on average and below 0.002% per patient; mean Jacobian determinant 0.992 ± 0.165
legacy_cells.EI: Against seven retrained non-agentic baselines: EF MAE 12.85% versus 27.03% for the best competing method; PhaseFlow3D FID 2.020 and FVD 0.683, compared with best baseline FVD 1.042
legacy_cells.EK: Ablations: removing the radial head raised EF MAE to 15.00% and reduced Vol R² to −0.244; radial-only reduced PSNR to 33.14 dB; removing volume-curve loss raised EF MAE to 14.66% and reduced Vol Corr to 0.785
legacy_cells.EL: Residual under-contraction remains: EF MAE is 12.85 percentage points, and the authors note smaller-than-clinical strain magnitudes; severe apical rotation in HCM stresses the residual pathway
legacy_cells.FL: Single ED 3D CMR volume → frozen CineVAE3D latent anchor and image features → phase-conditioned rectified-flow VelocityUNet4D → radial-contraction and learned-residual displacement fields → spatial transformer warps the ED image into a full cine sequence; no planner
legacy_cells.FM: Introduces PhaseFlow3D for ECG-free 4D cine CMR synthesis from a single ED volume, using piecewise-linear cardiac phase conditioning, latent rectified flow, and a physics-informed radial-plus-residual deformation decomposition; adds physiological EF and volume-curve supervision and evaluates downstream uses
legacy_cells.FN: On the combined test set, EF MAE 12.85%, Vol Corr 0.845, Vol R² 0.054, Vol MAE 0.110, FID 2.020, and FVD 0.683; only method with positive volume-curve R². Synthetic segmentation supervision retained 99.2% of all-real Dice; blind ED-to-ES LV label propagation Dice was 0.712 ± 0.129
legacy_cells.FO: EF MAE remains 12.85 percentage points; a single ED volume and canonical phase cannot determine the true patient-specific trajectory; validation on larger and more diverse cohorts is needed; experiments use ECG-gated cine acquisitions resampled to 16 slices; very thick/thin slabs and pronounced non-radial HCM motion need further study
legacy_cells.FP: Extend to free-breathing acquisitions and anchor frames other than ED; validate on larger and more diverse cine CMR cohorts toward clinical deployment
legacy_cells.FQ: Existing synthesis methods prioritize visual realism, which does not establish patient-specific EF or LV-volume accuracy; the study targets single-volume cine synthesis with explicit physiological supervision
legacy_cells.FR: The results establish retrospective benchmark synthesis and downstream-task utility, not prospective clinical benefit or clinical equivalence. The canonical population phase and one ED image cannot recover a patient's uniquely observed motion; generated dynamics remain model-based predictions, and clinical utility requires separate validation.
legacy_cells.FS: Reviewer mapping: M3 Belief-state service; M5 Dynamics adapter; M7 Outcome & causal layer
legacy_cells.FT: Reviewer lesson: Expose future-state forecasts through a time-aware dynamics interface and validate error versus horizon; treatment actions need separate evidence before intervention simulation.
